notes.title: Sports Sports
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155041/c19efa09ffef28e3f4503c9d41b5f7f42d1f261d.gif

Sports Sports, our retro-inspired take on arcade classics like Track & Field and Daley Thompson's Decathlon, is now live to Wishlist! 

Dive into: Sprint, Hurdles, Long Jump, Boxing, Relay, Long Distance, Swimming, Archery, Javelin, Shot Put, Weightlifting, Cycling, Triple Jump, BMX Race, Hammer, Shooting, Rowing, High Jump, High Diving, Pole Vault, Kayaking, Discus, Arm Wrestling, Rock Paper Scissors and more!


Got an athletics game or sport that you've always wished could be made into a game?! Let us know! We plan to make Sports Sports the largest sports game ever made and will be adding more events as we develop the game further.

Sports Sports is being developed by Broxcorp, an indie studio from London, UK.
Our first title, the explosive Shoot em'up Skies of Chaos is also coming to Steam soon!
